apply_hadamard_rotation: apply Hadamard rotation to a PyTorch model using inplace or transform backend based on config and data type
resolve_hadamard_backend: resolve the Hadamard backend to inplace or transform given a RotationConfig and quantization data type
to_config: normalize a rotation config string, dict, or RotationConfig into a validated RotationConfig instance
review_apply_hadamard_rotation: review the apply_hadamard_rotation function to understand how it dispatches between inplace and transform backends
test_resolve_hadamard_backend: test the resolve_hadamard_backend function with different RotationConfig backend values and data types
